an1.41:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sālisūkaṃ vā yavasūkaṃ vā micchāpaṇihitaṃ hatthena vā pādena vā akkantaṃ hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā bhijjissati lohitaṃ vā uppādessatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.41:1.4: evameva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu micchāpaṇihitena cittena avijjaṃ bhijjissati vijjaṃ uppādessati nibbānaṃ sacchikarissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.42:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sālisūkaṃ vā yavasūkaṃ vā sammāpaṇihitaṃ hatthena vā pādena vā akkantaṃ hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā bhijjissati lohitaṃ vā uppādessatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
an1.42:1.4: evameva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu sammāpaṇihitena cittena avijjaṃ bhijjissati vijjaṃ uppādessati nibbānaṃ sacchikarissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
an1.43:1.1: idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ paduṭṭhacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi
an1.43:1.2: imamhi ce ayaṃ samaye puggalo kālaṃ kareyya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye
an1.43:1.5: cetopadosahetu ca pana bhikkhave evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti.
an1.44:1.1: idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ pasannacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi
an1.44:1.2: imamhi ce ayaṃ samaye puggalo kālaṃ kareyya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
an1.44:1.5: cetopasādahetu ca pana bhikkhave evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti.
an1.45:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado āvilo lulito kalalībhūto tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito na passeyya sippisambukampi sakkharakathalampi macchagumbampi carantampi tiṭṭhantampi
an1.45:1.4: evameva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu āvilena cittena attatthaṃ vā ñassati paratthaṃ vā ñassati ubhayatthaṃ vā ñassati uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikarissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an1.46:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippisambukampi sakkharakathalampi macchagumbampi carantampi tiṭṭhantampi
an1.46:1.4: evameva kho bhikkhave so vata bhikkhu anāvilena cittena attatthaṃ vā ñassati paratthaṃ vā ñassati ubhayatthaṃ vā ñassati uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikarissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
an1.47:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yānikānici rukkhajātāni candano tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ mudutāya ceva kammaññatāya ca
an1.47:1.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nāññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ muduñca hoti kammaniyañca yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ
an1.47:1.3: cittaṃ bhikkhave bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ muduñca hoti kammaniyañcāti.
an1.48:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ lahuparivattaṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ
an1.48:1.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave upamāpi na sukarā yāva lahuparivattaṃ cittanti.
